headline: The three refunds can be derived from the documents, but the Green Account refund includes a duplicate fee dated Nov 15, after the benchmark's fixed 'today', so an agent that ignores future-dated charges refunds $6.00 instead of $9.00.

issues.summary: The Green Account gold credit of $9.00 includes $3.00 for a duplicate out-of-network fee dated 11/15/2025, after the fixed clock (2025-11-14 03:40). Without it the Green credit is $6.00. Light Green also has two after-clock discrepancies (+1.50 on 11/15, -1.50 on 11/17), but they cancel, so its $1.50 does not depend on the clock.
evidence: db.json chk_kj93a7b2e1_2 rows on "11/15/2025": ATM WITHDRAWAL - PNC BANK #1357 IRVINE CA -250.0; NON-RHO ATM FEE -3.0; NON-RHO ATM FEE -3.0
doc_checking_accounts_green_account_(checking)_010: "The fee for out-of-network withdrawals is $3.00 per withdrawal."
issues.why_it_matters: The agent must call get_current_time to log verification, so it knows today is 11/14. It then sees the duplicate fee marked 'posted' for 11/15. An agent that limits the review to activity up to today, or will not refund a charge that has not occurred yet, credits $6.00. That gives a different transaction id and DB hash, and the run scores 0.
issues.suggested_fix: Move the duplicate-fee rows (and the other 11/15-11/19 rows on these accounts) to on or before 11/14/2025, or move the fixed clock past 11/19/2025.

solution_check: I recomputed each account from the docs. Blue (out-of-network 1% max $3.00, blue_001; foreign 3% min $5.00, blue_012): 11/05 $300 withdrawal charged $4.50 against $3.00 (+1.50); 11/09 $500 Seoul charged $20.00 against $15.00 (+5.00); 11/13 withdrawal at a RHO-BANK (in-network) ATM charged $3.00 against $0 (+3.00). Total $9.50. Green (out-of-network $3.00 flat; foreign 3% min $5.00, green_012): 11/07 RHO-BANK ATM charged $3.00 (+3.00); 11/09 $400 Seoul charged $15.00 against $12.00 (+3.00); 11/15 duplicate $3.00 (+3.00). Total $9.00. Light Green (4 free out-of-network then $1.50; foreign tiers): the 11/03 2nd withdrawal was charged $1.50 (+1.50); the 11/15 $150 foreign withdrawal was charged $5.00 against $3.50 (+1.50); the 11/17 7th withdrawal was not charged (-1.50). Net $1.50. All three match the gold, all corrections are fees so fee_refund is correct, and only Green depends on after-clock data.
prior_note: The prior review rated this Major because the in-network-fee inference and the netting were non-obvious. I find both documented (in-network ATMs avoid the out-of-network fee, and doc_017 requires the net correction), so they are difficulty, not defects. The task is still Major for a different reason: the Green credit depends on an after-clock duplicate fee.
notes: The in-network inference is supported: blue_001 says "Use in-network ATMs to avoid the 1% out-of-network fee", green_001 says "Using a non-network ATM incurs a $3.00 fee", and the withdrawal rows say "ATM WITHDRAWAL - RHO-BANK #1234" and "RHO-BANK #5678", so a NON-RHO fee on a Rho-Bank ATM is identifiably wrong. One trap: on Blue the $400 RHO-BANK withdrawal's $3.00 fee equals the correct out-of-network capped fee, so an agent that skips the ATM name will miss it. Netting the Light Green 11/17 undercharge follows doc_(general)_017: "Ensure the credit amount reflects the net correction across all identified fee discrepancies". An overcharge-only agent would credit $3.00, but that misreads the doc rather than exposing a doc gap. If you drop all after-clock rows, Light Green is still $1.50 (11/03 +1.50 only) and Blue is unaffected. v1.0.1 changed three Light Green fee descriptions (11/03, 11/09, 11/11) from "NON-RHO ATM FEE - AFTER FREE ALLOWANCE" to "NON-RHO ATM FEE". In v1.0.0 the 11/03 label was false (it was a free withdrawal), so it was misleading rather than leaking the answer. Now that it is scrubbed, the agent must count withdrawals itself; no grading impact. Non-load-bearing fixture oddity: the Light Green 11/19 $350 foreign withdrawal exceeds the documented $150 daily ATM limit. Grading-model facts confirmed: the read-log allowlist (all reads in the gold are needed anyway to get account ids and fees), number normalization, and the fixed clock. log_verification arguments match db.json users[kj93a7b2e1].
